_note: Book intros are written by our team in our own words. They contain no ESV text.

Genesis.author: Traditionally Moses
Genesis.focus: Beginnings: God creates the world, people break trust with him, and God starts a rescue plan through one family — Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph.
objectives: God made everything, and he called it good.
Every person is made in God's image and has great worth.
Sin breaks our relationship with God and each other.
God keeps his promises, even when people mess up.

Luke.author: Luke, a doctor and travel companion of Paul
Luke.focus: A careful, orderly account of Jesus' life, showing that he came for everyone — the poor, the outsider, and the forgotten.
objectives: Jesus is the promised Savior for all people.
God cares deeply about the lost and the overlooked.
Prayer and the Holy Spirit play a big part in Jesus' ministry.
The good news is true and can be trusted.

John.author: John, one of Jesus' twelve disciples
John.focus: Who is Jesus? John answers with signs, conversations, and 'I am' statements so readers will believe and have life in his name.
objectives: Jesus is fully God and became a real human.
Jesus' miracles are signs pointing to who he is.
Believing in Jesus brings eternal life.
Jesus' followers are called to love one another.
